meta.name: CIA
meta.description: Sigue una asociación entre un agente del FBI y un agente de la CIA que trabajan juntos en un equipo de trabajo clandestino para prevenir el terrorismo doméstico en Nueva York.

videos.title: Directed Energy
videos.overview: When a top-secret weapon is stolen from a U.S. defense contractor, CIA agent Colin Glass is paired with FBI agent Bill Goodman to investigate. Their partnership gets off to a rocky start, but they soon realize their opposing viewpoints may be their greatest asset.

videos.title: Fatal Defect
videos.overview: When a known smuggler is flagged at the New York border with unidentified cargo, Colin and Bill head upstate to track. To find this smuggler, they must enlist the help of a foreign intelligence officer looking to defect.

videos.title: Bridge of Lies
videos.overview: When a deeply embedded U.S. intelligence officer is detained in Hong Kong, Nikki insists on traveling there to bring him home but her cover is blown.

videos.title: Forced Labor
videos.overview: When a wanted Belarusian national is discovered posing as an expecting father, Colin and Bill work to expose an international illegal baby smuggling ring.

videos.title: Deep Cover
videos.overview: After a cyber engineer and her family are killed in a targeted attack, Colin and Bill rush to stop the culprits before they strike again.

videos.title: Pledge of Allegiance
videos.overview: After Colin receives a tip on an upcoming terror plot, the team recovers a young man who was kidnapped nine years ago in Turkey and dig into his time in captivity to help stop the attack. Meanwhile, Bill looks into someone very close to Colin.

videos.title: Elimination Game
videos.overview: When handling security for an international soccer game, a bomb threat leads Colin and Bill to two players who are being hunted after they go missing. As the case evolves, the team leans on FBI's Special Agent in Charge Isobel Castille.

videos.title: Orbital
videos.overview: When a crashed satellite containing dangerous nuclear material disappears, Bill and Colin work with an undercover Gina to recruit the help of a retired arms dealer to help track it down.

videos.title: Blood Money
videos.overview: A woman with intel on a dangerous terror leader connects Colin and Bill to a family business engaged in terror operations. Now, they must find and turn a new asset to take down the entire operation. Meanwhile, Bill makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Rare Earth
videos.overview: When a foreign diplomat is killed after sneaking into the U.S. under unknown circumstances, Colin and Bill discover that a rare mineral with potential to disrupt international relations may be the reason he was targeted.

videos.title: Forbidden Eye
videos.overview: When Colin learns his CIA mentor has gone dark, he enlists Bill and the team to help track them down. But as they get closer, the operation reveals significant information about the identity of the mole.

videos.title: Broken Glass
videos.overview: Colin and Bill race to stop a company from covering up their intelligence theft while taking down a dangerous person from Colin's past.

videos.title: The Deep
videos.overview: When a known cartel fixer arrives in NYC, the team tracks him down and discovers the body of a DEA agent. After it becomes clear the case is not what it seems, the team must work quickly to prevent additional murders. Meanwhile, Bill makes a shocking discovery when he returns to work after the death of his father, and the team enlists the help of Special Agent Stuart Scola.

videos.title: Dead Drop
videos.overview: After a Russian spy is poisoned by his own comrades, he offers to help the team neutralize a threat against U.S. assets in Russia in exchange for the dying spy's final wish: revenge.

videos.title: Radio Active
videos.overview: In order to stop a terrorist cell carrying out a chemical bombing at an unknown location in the city, the team joins forces with an old school code breaker who is suffering from agoraphobia. Together they decipher a seemingly unbreakable cipher. Meanwhile, Colin wrestles with Toni's return to the field, and Bill braces for Katie's response to his recent admission.

videos.title: Black Tie Optional
videos.overview: When a prominent investor begins selling highly sensitive information to Korean agents, the team must go deep undercover at a high-end gala event to prevent a deadly invasion. Meanwhile, Bill struggles with troubling discoveries of his father's past.

videos.title: Real Intelligence
videos.overview: When an extremely powerful and dangerous AI model is stolen by an employee, Colin and Bill look to track her down before she can sell it to the highest bidder. Meanwhile, Bill makes new revelations about his father.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: When a targeted explosion rocks the Upper East Side and kills an international arms dealer, the team learns the culprit is assassin Felix Vincente. Meanwhile, Bill makes a difficult decision in order to stop him before he turns the fight against the CIA.

videos.title: Inside Men
videos.overview: Bill and Colin go deep undercover to stop a group of international class warriors planning a violent attack that will be streamed live to millions. Meanwhile, Bill wrestles with a secret he's keeping from Colin.
